name: RUN_RECEIPT_SHADOWING_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: RUN_RECEIPT_SHADOWING_20261107 — portfolio-repricer graded UNPROVEN 'no_run_record' while every
fire wrote a LaneRunReceipt@v2 (status ok, exit 0, started/finished, produced_count 34).
Its declared output signal is data/portfolios/state/holdings.json, a business store several writers touch;
receipt_candidates lists a declared *.json output first and read_receipt accepts it because it carries
as_of, so the lane's own data/runtime/portfolio-repricer_last.json was never read and a pseudo-run whose
start was the store's as_of (result unknown) also suppressed the real receipt in lane_history.
The rule this gate pins: a document that names no run start or finish is not a run receipt. The receipt
that names its run wins; the store keeps serving as the lane's OUTPUT time (freshness), which is what it
is; and a lane with only a store and no receipt keeps exactly the evidence it has today.
Hermetic: temp trees and hand-written JSON; no production store, no database, no network.
